pages.text: Create machines do not work through menus. They act on $(thing)items sitting in front of them$(): items on a belt, on a depot, or inside a basin. Most of them need $(l:create_basics/rotation)rotation$(/l) to run.$(br2)Hover a machine and hold W for its Ponder.

pages.title: Mechanical Press
pages.text: Hits whatever is under it. On a belt or depot it presses ingots into sheets. Over a basin it compacts the contents.

Pressing a plain item makes a $(item)sheet$(): iron, gold, copper and brass sheets are building blocks for later machines.$(br2)Over a $(item)Basin$(), the press compacts: any filled 2x2 or 3x3 crafting recipe, plus some extras (some need heat, see $(l:create_basics/heat)Heat$(/l)).

pages.title: Mechanical Mixer
pages.text: Sits above a basin and stirs. Handles any shapeless crafting recipe, plus extra recipes like alloying.

pages.title: Basin
pages.text: Holds items and fluids for the mixer or press above it. Has no output until you give it one.

Brass is the classic mixer job: copper and zinc ingots in a basin, with a $(l:create_basics/heat)heated$(/l) burner under it. Check JEI for the exact mix.$(br2)If two recipes fit the same contents, put an item in the machine's filter slot to pick one.

$(thing)Basin output$(): put a belt, funnel, depot or chute below and to the side, and the basin shows a faucet and pushes finished items out. With no output block it keeps results inside, useful when they are ingredients for the next step.$(br2)If you pull from a basin, use a $(l:create_basics/item_logistics)filter$(/l) so unprocessed items stay.
